text: There is something profoundly wrong with a system that allows children to go hungry in the wealthiest nation on Earth. As a teacher in a Title I school, I have watched students try to concentrate on lessons while their stomachs growl because they didn't eat breakfast. The free lunch program helps, but it doesn't reach every child who needs it, and the stigma of being visibly singled out as a 'free lunch kid' causes real harm to children's sense of belonging. I support universal free school meals — not because it's a political position, but because I have seen the difference a full stomach makes in a child's ability to learn.
